description: Commit 27 — Hospital management at /dashboard/admin/hospitals and user management at /dashboard/admin/users. Paginated tables with verify (hospitals) and ban/unban (users) actions. Extends adminApi in src/lib/admin.ts with paginated list endpoints; adds banUser/unbanUser actions to src/app/actions/admin.ts. Independent from FEAT-002 in terms of UI, but FEAT-003 depends on FEAT-002 having created src/app/actions/admin.ts and the adminApi extensions.
steps: 1. Extend src/lib/admin.ts: add two paginated list methods. Import `Hospital, UserProfile` are already imported from FEAT-002. Add: `hospitals: (token: string, query?: { page?: number; limit?: number; verified?: boolean }) => apiPaginated<Hospital[]>('/admin/hospitals', { token, cache: 'no-store', query })` and `users: (token: string, query?: { page?: number; limit?: number; isBanned?: boolean }) => apiPaginated<UserProfile[]>('/admin/users', { token, cache: 'no-store', query })`. Keep all existing methods unchanged.

2. Extend src/app/actions/admin.ts: add two more exported async functions: `banUser(userId: string): Promise<ActionResult>` — calls `adminApi.banUser(token, userId)`, `revalidatePath('/dashboard/admin/users')`, returns `{ ok: true }`; `unbanUser(userId: string): Promise<ActionResult>` — calls `adminApi.unbanUser(token, userId)`, same revalidatePath, returns `{ ok: true }`. Both wrap in try/catch returning `{ error: messageFor(error) }`. adminToken() helper already exists from FEAT-002.

3. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/hospitals/page.tsx as an async Server Component. Metadata `{ title: 'Hospitals' }`. Parse `page` (default 1) and `filter` ('all' | 'unverified') from searchParams. Pass `verified: filter === 'unverified' ? false : undefined` to `adminApi.hospitals(token, { page, limit: 20, verified })`. Render: Eyebrow 'Hospital management' + h1 'Hospitals'. Two filter tabs (inline chip row, same pattern as status tabs in filters.tsx): 'All' and 'Unverified'. Each tab is a `<ButtonLink href='?filter=...' variant={active ? 'soft' : 'ghost'} size='sm'>`. Below the tabs, a table-like list: for each hospital render a `<HospitalRow hospital={hospital} />` component (created below). Total count shown above the list. Pagination prev/next links via `<ButtonLink>`. Empty state if no hospitals.

4. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/hospitals/components/hospital-row.tsx as a `'use client'` component. Props: `hospital: Hospital`. Import `verifyHospital` from `@/app/actions/admin`, `ConfirmDialog` from `@/components/ui/confirm-dialog`, `Button` from `@/components/ui/button`, `BadgeCheck, Clock` from `lucide-react`, `toast` from `sonner`, `useTransition, useState` from `react`. Layout: `
`. Left: hospital name (font-bold), address (text-sm text-ink-muted), user email if available (text-xs text-ink-faint). Right: if `hospital.verified`, show ` Verified` (no action button). If not verified, show `` and mount `` when confirming with `onConfirm` calling `verifyHospital(hospital.id)` via `startTransition`, success toast 'Hospital verified.', error toast on failure.

5. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/hospitals/loading.tsx: export default `HospitalsLoading()` with 10 row skeletons: `
`.

6. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/users/page.tsx as an async Server Component. Metadata `{ title: 'Users' }`. Parse `page` (default 1) and `filter` ('all' | 'banned') from searchParams. Pass `isBanned: filter === 'banned' ? true : undefined` to `adminApi.users(token, { page, limit: 20, isBanned })`. Render: Eyebrow 'User management' + h1 'Users'. Filter tabs 'All' / 'Banned'. List of `<UserRow user={user} />` components. Total count. Pagination. Empty state.

7. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/users/components/user-row.tsx as a `'use client'` component. Props: `user: UserProfile`. Import `banUser, unbanUser` from `@/app/actions/admin`, `ConfirmDialog`, `Button`, `Ban, UserCheck` from `lucide-react`, `toast`, `useTransition, useState`. Layout mirrors HospitalRow. Left: email (font-bold), role badge (`{user.role}`), joined date using `formatDate(user.createdAt)` from `@/lib/format`. Right: if `user.isBanned`, show a red badge 'Banned' + ``. If not banned, show ``. Ban confirm dialog has `tone='danger'`, title 'Ban this user?', body 'The account will be blocked immediately. You can unban them at any time.', confirmLabel 'Ban user'. Unban dialog has default tone, title 'Unban this user?', confirmLabel 'Unban'. Actions call `banUser(user.id)` or `unbanUser(user.id)` via `startTransition`. Toast on success/failure.
8. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/users/loading.tsx: export default `UsersLoading()` with 10 row skeletons identical in shape to HospitalsLoading.
9. Commit: `git add src/lib/admin.ts src/app/actions/admin.ts src/app/dashboard/admin/hospitals/ src/app/dashboard/admin/users/ && git commit -m 'feat: add hospital and user management'`
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 — no TypeScript errors
src/app/dashboard/admin/hospitals/page.tsx and users/page.tsx are async Server Components
HospitalRow and UserRow are 'use client' components using ConfirmDialog
banUser and unbanUser are exported from src/app/actions/admin.ts
adminApi.hospitals and adminApi.users are exported from src/lib/admin.ts
